comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Outsources services to universities for a revenue share; it doesn't operate institutions or collect tuition directly, so the model differs.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Operates for-profit allied health and nursing colleges funded by tuition and student aid, like Rasmussen, though regional and smaller.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Operates for-profit, mostly online universities for adult students on Title IV tuition, including health sciences programs.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Operates online and campus universities for working adults, with employer and military tuition channels, funded by Title IV tuition.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Mainly K-12 virtual schooling paid by public school funding, a different customer base and regulatory model than adult higher education.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: For-profit postsecondary career training schools funded by tuition, Title IV and GI Bill; it is campus-based and trade-focused rather than online.
